When Jedi Apprentice [[Jaden Korr]] went on a mission to [[Nar Kreeta]] to save a group of elders from a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crimelord, the prisoners were guarded by a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]], and the thugs of the Hutt crimelord had set up a '''betting parlor''', betting on who could get past the rancor.
